revision_summary: One quote timestamp error and a handful of schema-reference/framing issues need correction before shipping: (1) Fix bill_anchor_audit.bill_ts — the quote 'K. Yeah. Probably $300 a month or so.' is at [05:37], not [10:24]; the 10:24 timestamp actually contains 'Hell, hell, yeah. I won't be able to help you on that because I'm not finding anything.' Correct the ts field. (2) Rename/reframe trajectory_verdict.outcome_dispute — no v1 tag was provided in the input, so 'disputing' language is misleading; reframe as a straightforward observed-outcome determination. (3) Fix script_coverage row label 'tax_credit_qualifier' → should be 'credit_qualifier' (the quote is about the credit score threshold, not the ITC tax credit disclosure). (4) In cherry_pick_moments[1] (curiosity_creation_failure), swap or add the schema_reference to rebuttals.price_estimate_before_design, which is the more precise match for a customer asking cost/rebates before a design — curiosity_over_features is about rep-initiated feature explanations, not customer-initiated pricing questions. (5) Add a cherry_pick_moments entry for the 05:44 premature verify-completion claim ('everything looks good here on my end') tied to verify.required_completion_threshold, since this is currently buried only inside rep_intent evidence. (6) Consider tying the 10:45 'must do it online... paperless' line explicitly to bill_collection.alternative_paths so the coaching alternative has a concrete schema anchor rather than a generic pivot suggestion. These are targeted fixes; the overall trajectory read (energy_leaked, no_appointment, unanchored close) is well-supported and should be retained."
